boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain CUNY Brooklyn College
boards.description: An under-21-safe guide to the late-night dining rituals and essential after-hours spots for Brooklyn College students near the Flatbush campus.

cards.title: Late-Night Apps at the Junction
cards.subtitle: 2201 Nostrand Ave
cards.notes: Visit this neighborhood staple for late-night dining until midnight daily. It is a primary sit-down option for students near the Brooklyn Junction transit hub.
cards.short_summary: A reliable late-night sit-down restaurant located at the busy Brooklyn Junction intersection.
cards.evidence_claim: Applebee's at 2201 Nostrand Ave is open until 12:00 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Applebee's Grill + Bar Restaurant in Brooklyn, NY, 11210
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM every night for dine-in and takeout.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Hillel Place Anchor
cards.subtitle: 2202 Hillel Pl
cards.notes: Stop by this 24/7 convenience hub directly adjacent to the campus entrance for snacks, coffee, and quick meals at any hour of the night.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store located on the pedestrian-heavy Hillel Place right next to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The 7-Eleven at 2202 Hillel Pl is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for walk-in customers.

cards.title: Midnight Coffee on Nostrand
cards.subtitle: 2129 Nostrand Ave
cards.notes: Fuel your late-night study sessions with coffee and donuts at this location open until 2:00 AM, situated just north of the main campus gates.
cards.short_summary: A late-night coffee and bakery stop on Nostrand Avenue serving the student community until 2:00 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dunkin' at 2129 Nostrand Ave is open until 2:00 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 2:00 AM.

cards.title: Late-Night Halal Chicken
cards.subtitle: 1388 Flatbush Ave
cards.notes: Grab a quick meal of fried chicken or gyro at this neighborhood staple open until 4:00 AM, a popular choice for students heading home late.
cards.short_summary: A classic Brooklyn late-night fried chicken and halal spot on Flatbush Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Kennedy Fried Chicken at 1388 Flatbush Ave is open until 4:00 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Kennedy Fried Chicken Delivery Menu | 1388 Flatbush Ave
cards.access_notes: Open until 4:00 AM for takeout and delivery.

cards.title: The 11 PM Burrito Run
cards.subtitle: 2166 Nostrand Ave
cards.notes: Enjoy a late dinner at this fast-casual favorite open until 11:00 PM daily, located conveniently across from the Brooklyn Junction shopping area.
cards.short_summary: A popular fast-casual Mexican grill with late evening hours near the college.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle at 2166 Nostrand Ave is open until 11:00 PM daily.
cards.source_title: Chipotle 2166 Nostrand Ave in Brooklyn, NY
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 10:45 AM to 11:00 PM.

cards.title: Late-Night Essentials at the Triangle
cards.subtitle: Triangle Junction
cards.notes: Pick up groceries or dorm supplies until 10:00 PM at this multi-level retail anchor that serves as a central landmark for the campus community.
cards.short_summary: A major retail destination at Triangle Junction with late evening hours for student needs.
cards.evidence_claim: Target at Brooklyn Junction is open until 10:00 PM daily.
cards.source_title: Target Brooklyn Junction Store, Brooklyn, NY
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 10:00 PM.

cards.title: Famous Platters Near Campus
cards.subtitle: 2142 Nostrand Ave
cards.notes: Visit this brick-and-mortar location of the famous NYC cart for chicken and gyro platters until 11:00 PM, just steps from the Flatbush Ave-Brooklyn College station.
cards.short_summary: A storefront location of the iconic NYC halal brand serving students until late evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The Halal Guys at 2142 Nostrand Ave is open until 11:00 PM daily.
cards.source_title: The Halal Guys - 2142 Nostrand Ave, Brooklyn
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 11:00 PM.

cards.title: Cajun Fries After Class
cards.subtitle: 2134 Nostrand Ave
cards.notes: Grab a spicy chicken sandwich or tenders until 11:00 PM at this location situated in the heart of the student-frequented Nostrand Avenue corridor.
cards.short_summary: A popular fast-food chicken spot with late-night availability near the college.
cards.evidence_claim: Popeyes at 2134 Nostrand Ave is open until 11:00 PM daily.
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 11:00 PM.

cards.title: The On-Campus Evening Hub
cards.subtitle: Boylan Hall Basement
cards.notes: While not open past midnight, this is the primary on-campus evening dining spot, serving global cuisine and coffee until 7:00 PM for late afternoon classes.
cards.short_summary: The main campus dining hall providing evening meals for the Brooklyn College community.
cards.evidence_claim: Boylan Hall Cafeteria is open Monday–Thursday until 7:00 PM.
cards.source_title: BK Campus Eats: Boylan Hall Cafeteria - Brooklyn College
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Thursday 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM; Friday until 4:00 PM.

cards.title: Evening Study Sips
cards.subtitle: 2162 Nostrand Ave
cards.notes: Find a familiar place to study or grab a late-night latte until 10:00 PM at this Starbucks located right at the Brooklyn Junction transit entrance.
cards.short_summary: A central coffee shop with evening hours serving as a study and meeting spot for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Starbucks at 2162 Nostrand Ave is open until 10:00 PM daily.
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 10:00 PM.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional student hubs and quiet retreats across Brooklyn College's Georgian-style campus, from specialized media labs to tranquil garden spaces.

cards.title: Late-Night Study at Whitehead Hall
cards.subtitle: Whitehead Hall, First Floor
cards.notes: Access 80 workstations and lounge seating in this dedicated computing facility. It offers full printing and scanning services and stays open later than the main library stacks.
cards.short_summary: A high-capacity computing and study lounge located in Whitehead Hall with extended hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library Café is located on the first floor of Whitehead Hall and has 80 workstations, lounge seating, and coffee services.
cards.source_title: Library Café - BC Knowledge for Students
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 9am-8:30pm and Friday 9:30am-6pm during standard terms.

cards.title: Tranquil Retreat by the Library
cards.subtitle: Adjacent to the Library
cards.notes: Visit this scenic campus landmark to see resident turtles and koi. It serves as a quiet outdoor sanctuary for students to relax or study between classes.
cards.short_summary: A peaceful outdoor garden and pond home to turtles and koi fish near the campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lily Pond is a sanctuary for students to study or relax and is home to a micro-ecosystem of turtles and koi.
cards.source_title: What the Campus Has to Offer | Brooklyn College
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public campus space accessible during college operating hours.

cards.title: Unwind with Free Pool and Foosball
cards.subtitle: Student Center, First Floor
cards.notes: Head to the first floor for a laid-back environment featuring free pool tables and foosball. The basement level also offers ping pong for student recreation.
cards.short_summary: A recreational hub in the Student Center offering free billiards and tabletop games.
cards.evidence_claim: The Game Room on the first floor of the Student Center offers free pool games and foosball for students.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 10am-9pm and Friday 10am-3pm.

cards.title: The Quietest Tables on Campus
cards.subtitle: Boylan Hall, Top Floor
cards.notes: Find secluded study tables and chairs at the ends of the corridors on the fifth floor. This area is known among students for being exceptionally quiet and often vacant.
cards.short_summary: A lesser-known quiet study area located in the top-floor corridors of Boylan Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The 5th floor of Boylan Hall features vacant seats and medium-size square tables at the end of each corridor that are very quiet.
cards.access_notes: Accessible via stairs or elevator during Boylan Hall building hours.

cards.title: Student-Run Airwaves at Whitehead
cards.subtitle: Whitehead Hall, Room 306A
cards.notes: Visit the heart of student media where volunteers run a 24/7 free-form radio station. They host open hours for students interested in broadcasting and podcasting.
cards.short_summary: The campus radio station in Whitehead Hall where students produce and stream original content.
cards.evidence_claim: WBCR is a free-form, student-run radio station located in Room 306A of Whitehead Hall.
cards.access_notes: Open hours typically held Monday-Thursday in the afternoons.

cards.title: Low-Traffic Tech Hub
cards.subtitle: Student Center, First Floor
cards.notes: Utilize this computer lab for quick assignments; it is known for having less foot traffic than the main library labs while maintaining the same high-speed bandwidth.
cards.short_summary: A quieter alternative computer lab located on the first floor of the Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Computer Corner has less traffic than other labs on campus with the same bandwidth.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 10am-9pm and Friday 10am-3pm.

cards.title: Workout at the West Quad
cards.subtitle: West Quad Center, Room 123
cards.notes: Access modern exercise equipment and recreational facilities. This center is the primary spot for students to maintain fitness between academic sessions.
cards.short_summary: The main student fitness and recreation facility located in the West Quad Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The West Quad Fitness Center offers independent exercise and general fitness for students in Room 123.
cards.source_title: West Quad Fitness Center - Brooklyn College Athletics
cards.access_notes: Valid Brooklyn College ID required for entry; hours vary by semester.

cards.title: Deep Focus in the Stacks
cards.subtitle: Library, Multiple Floors
cards.notes: Find designated silent zones throughout the library for distraction-free work. These areas are strictly monitored to ensure a quiet environment for intense study.
cards.short_summary: Designated quiet zones within the main library for students requiring total silence.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brooklyn College Library offers designated silent study spaces and quiet conversation spaces for students.
cards.access_notes: Available during regular library operating hours.

cards.title: Social Hub at BK Campus Eats
cards.subtitle: Boylan Hall, Basement Level
cards.notes: Gather at the campus's primary dining hall, which features diverse global cuisine stations and a coffee shop. It serves as a major social crossroads for the student body.
cards.short_summary: The central campus dining facility and social gathering spot located in Boylan Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Boylan Hall cafeteria, operated by BK Campus Eats, is a hub where students dine and socialize.
cards.source_title: BK Campus Eats: Boylan Hall Cafeteria
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 8am-7pm and Friday 9am-4pm during classes.

cards.title: Quiet Corner in the SU
cards.subtitle: Student Center, Fifth Floor
cards.notes: Escape the noise of the lower levels by heading to the fifth-floor study room. It provides a dedicated quiet space within the otherwise bustling Student Center.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet study room located on the upper floor of the Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: If you desire quiet time to study, visit our Study Room on the fifth floor of the Student Center.
cards.access_notes: Open during Student Center operating hours, typically until 9pm Monday-Thursday.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover the best spots on and around the CUNY Brooklyn College campus for social activities and relaxation that require no admission fees or purchases.

cards.title: Relax by the Lily Pond
cards.subtitle: Central Campus Landmark
cards.notes: Find a spot on the grass or a nearby bench to watch the goldfish and turtles in this historic Georgian-style campus centerpiece.
cards.short_summary: A scenic campus landmark featuring a pond with goldfish and turtles, surrounded by grassy quads and elm trees.
cards.evidence_claim: The original design called for a lily pond, gardens, and grassy quadrangles; these remain among the most beautiful in the metropolitan area.
cards.access_notes: Open to students with valid ID; visitors must enter through designated gates and present government ID.

cards.title: Play Free Pool and Foosball
cards.subtitle: Student Center First Floor
cards.notes: Head to the first floor for free games of pool and foosball, or visit the lower level for a round of ping pong with friends.
cards.short_summary: A social hub in the Student Center offering free recreational games like pool, foosball, and ping pong for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Game Room on the first floor is a laid-back setting where students enjoy free pool games and foosball.
cards.access_notes: Valid Brooklyn College ID required for entry; open Monday-Thursday 10 a.m.–9 p.m. and Friday 10 a.m.–3 p.m.

cards.title: Study in Silent Spaces
cards.subtitle: Academic Core
cards.notes: Utilize the library's designated silent study floors or cozy nooks for focused work without the distraction of noise.
cards.short_summary: The campus library provides multiple floors of silent study areas and comfortable nooks for individual academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brooklyn College Library offers students comfortable rooms and nooks to study and rest in between classes.
cards.access_notes: Access requires a valid CUNY ID card; hours vary by semester and intersession.

cards.entity_name: The Art Gallery at Brooklyn College
cards.title: View Contemporary Art
cards.subtitle: Boylan Hall Top Floor
cards.notes: Explore rotating exhibitions of professional and student work in this light-filled gallery space overlooking the campus.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery showcasing diverse professional and student art exhibitions, fostering interdisciplinary learning.
cards.evidence_claim: The Art Gallery at Brooklyn College showcases an array of works across media; it is a place for the campus community to come together.
cards.source_title: The Art Gallery at Brooklyn College
cards.access_notes: Open to the campus community and the public during exhibition hours; located in Boylan Hall.

cards.title: Join a Community Shabbat
cards.subtitle: Hillel House
cards.notes: Attend community Shabbat dinners 3-4 times per semester for free meals, themed discussions, and social games.
cards.short_summary: Free community Shabbat meals and social gatherings hosted by Tanger Hillel for all Brooklyn College students.
cards.evidence_claim: We celebrate Shabbat as a big community 3-4 times a semester at the Hillel House. All meals are FREE.
cards.source_title: Holidays | Services | Shabbat - Tanger Hillel Brooklyn College
cards.access_notes: All students are welcome; check the Hillel calendar for specific dates and registration requirements.

cards.title: Work Out for Free
cards.subtitle: West Quad Center
cards.notes: Access the gym, swimming pool, and track during recreational hours to stay active between your classes.
cards.short_summary: A comprehensive fitness facility for students featuring a gym, pool, and track with no additional membership fees.
cards.evidence_claim: The West Quad Center is home to recreational and fitness facilities; students can use the fitness center and swimming pool.
cards.access_notes: Valid Brooklyn College ID required; access is subject to current recreation center hours.

cards.title: Hang Out at the Library Café
cards.subtitle: Whitehead Hall First Floor
cards.notes: Relax in the lounge seating or use one of the 80 workstations in this 24/7-accessible space during the semester.
cards.short_summary: A popular 24-hour student lounge and computer lab located in Whitehead Hall, ideal for late-night study or socializing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library Café is located on the first floor of Whitehead Hall and has 80 workstations and lounge seating.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours during the fall and spring semesters for students with valid ID; closed during recesses.

cards.title: Find Peace in the Reflection Room
cards.subtitle: Student Center
cards.notes: Visit this dedicated quiet space for meditation, prayer, or a moment of silence away from the campus bustle.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet space within the Student Center for students to engage in reflection, meditation, or prayer.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Center includes a Quiet Reflection Room for students who desire quiet time or to wind down.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Student Center; accessible during building hours with a valid student ID.

cards.title: Attend International Coffee Hour
cards.subtitle: Boylan Hall Room 2154
cards.notes: Meet students from around the world while enjoying free coffee, snacks, and board games during this weekly social event.
cards.short_summary: A weekly social gathering for the entire college community featuring free refreshments and games.
cards.evidence_claim: International Student Coffee Hour: We invite the entire college community to join us for free coffee, snacks, and games.
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; typically held on Tuesdays from 12:30 p.m. to 1:30 p.m. in Boylan Hall.

cards.title: Sunbathe on the West Quad
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Social Space
cards.notes: Join fellow students on the large grassy lawn for sunbathing, frisbee, or group study sessions during warm weather.
cards.short_summary: The primary outdoor gathering space on campus, used for student events, relaxation, and informal recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The West Quad is a central outdoor space where the LGBTQ+ Resource Center and other groups host outdoor fairs and events.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor area within the campus gates; subject to campus access policies.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: From silent library floors to active student center lounges, these ten spots offer the best environments for focused academic work at Brooklyn College.

cards.entity_name: Brooklyn College Library Silent Study Spaces
cards.title: Library Silent Study Floors
cards.subtitle: Brooklyn College Library
cards.notes: Head to designated silent zones for absolute quiet. These areas strictly prohibit conversation and phone use to ensure a distraction-free environment for deep focus.
cards.short_summary: Designated silent zones within the main library for distraction-free individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: The library offers designated silent study spaces for students seeking a quiet environment.
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; check the library website for daily schedules.

cards.title: Topfer Library Café
cards.subtitle: Whitehead Hall, First Floor
cards.notes: Utilize 80 workstations and lounge seating in this 24/7-capable space. It features printing, scanning, and a snack bar for long study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A high-tech study lounge in Whitehead Hall with 80 workstations and 24-hour access potential.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library Café is located on the first floor of Whitehead Hall and has 80 workstations and lounge seating.
cards.source_title: Library Café - BC Knowledge for Students

cards.title: Student Center 5th Floor Study Room

cards.evidence_claim: If you desire quiet time to study, visit our Study Room on the fifth floor of the Student Center.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 10am-9pm, Friday 10am-3pm.

cards.title: Gerboth Music Library
cards.subtitle: Library, 2nd Floor

cards.short_summary: A specialized library on the second floor of the main library building focused on music study.

cards.title: Boylan Hall Learning Center

cards.evidence_claim: There are 17 group study rooms available for use by Brooklyn College students on a first come, first served basis.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Room - Library Event Calendar
cards.access_notes: Must request in person at the New Media Desk, 2nd Floor Library.

cards.title: Student Center Computer Corner
cards.subtitle: Student Center, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Drop by for a quick session to finish papers. This lab typically has less traffic than other campus facilities while maintaining high bandwidth.
cards.short_summary: A convenient first-floor computer lab in the Student Center for quick academic tasks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Computer Corner on the first floor has less traffic than other labs on campus with the same bandwidth.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 10am-9pm, Friday 10am-3pm.

cards.title: Boylan Hall 5th Floor Nooks
cards.subtitle: Boylan Hall, 5th Floor
cards.notes: Trek to the top floor for secluded tables and a quiet atmosphere. These spots are often overlooked due to the walk, offering a peaceful retreat.
cards.short_summary: Quiet, secluded study tables located at the ends of the fifth-floor corridors in Boylan Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Hidden at each end of the 5th floor at Boylan Hall, lays vacant seats and a medium-size square table for two.
cards.source_title: The Best Place to Eat or Study Alone in Brooklyn College
cards.access_notes: Accessible via stairs or elevator in Boylan Hall during building operating hours.

cards.title: West Quad Center Lounges
cards.subtitle: West Quad Center
cards.notes: Find modern seating and open spaces in this central service hub. It is convenient for studying between administrative appointments or gym sessions.
cards.short_summary: Modern, open-plan study areas located within the West Quad Center building.
cards.evidence_claim: The West Quad Center is home to student services and recreational facilities, offering light-filled spaces.
cards.access_notes: Open during standard building hours; typically follows administrative office schedules.

cards.title: New Media Center
cards.subtitle: Library, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Access high-end creative software and hardware for academic projects. This space is tailored for students working on digital media and design assignments.
cards.short_summary: A technology-focused study and production space on the library's second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: The New Media Center on the 2nd floor provides specialized technology and study space.
cards.access_notes: Check the New Media Center desk for specific equipment loan and room access rules.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the streets and corridors surrounding Brooklyn College, from the bustling Flatbush Junction to the historic residential blocks of Fiske Terrace.

cards.title: Hillel Place Plaza
cards.subtitle: Hillel Place corridor
cards.notes: Relax at this pedestrian plaza featuring movable furniture and greenery, serving as a transition between the campus and the busy Flatbush Junction hub.
cards.short_summary: A pedestrian-only public plaza located on Hillel Place between Flatbush Avenue and Kenilworth Place.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillel Place Plaza is a pedestrian plaza established by the NYC DOT in partnership with the Flatbush Junction BID, providing public space for students and residents.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 as a public pedestrian space.

cards.title: Flatbush Junction
cards.subtitle: Flatbush Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Visit this major commercial intersection to find national retailers, local Caribbean eateries, and the terminal for the 2 and 5 subway lines.
cards.short_summary: The primary commercial and transit hub at the intersection of Flatbush and Nostrand Avenues.
cards.evidence_claim: Flatbush Junction is a thriving commercial district and transit hub serving Brooklyn College students with over 250 ground-floor retail businesses.
cards.access_notes: Public commercial district; individual business hours vary.

cards.title: Avenue H Station House
cards.subtitle: Avenue H corridor
cards.notes: Sit in the bronze rocking chairs on the porch of this landmarked 1906 shingled cottage, the only subway station house originally built as a real estate office.
cards.short_summary: A historic, landmarked wooden station house serving the Q train at Avenue H.
cards.evidence_claim: The Avenue H Station House is a designated NYC landmark, originally built in 1906 as a real estate office for the Fiske Terrace development.
cards.source_title: Avenue H Station House Designation Report - NYC LPC
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible station house; porch area is open to the public.

cards.title: Nostrand Avenue Retail
cards.subtitle: Nostrand Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk this busy stretch to access student-friendly services like the local post office, hardware stores, and quick-service dining options.
cards.short_summary: A key north-south commercial artery bordering the eastern edge of the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Nostrand Avenue between Glenwood Road and Avenue H is a primary retail corridor for the Flatbush Junction BID, housing numerous small businesses.
cards.source_title: Business Resource Guide - Flatbush Junction BID
cards.access_notes: Public street; retail hours typically 9 AM to 8 PM.

cards.title: Newman Catholic Center
cards.subtitle: Glenwood Road corridor
cards.notes: Visit this late-Victorian house for quiet study space, community service opportunities, and social gatherings open to all students.
cards.short_summary: A student center and chapel located in a historic house on Glenwood Road.
cards.evidence_claim: The Newman Catholic Center at Brooklyn College is located at 2401 Glenwood Road and serves as a hub for student faith and social life.
cards.access_notes: Open during academic terms; check event calendar for specific hours.

cards.title: FOUND Study Midwood
cards.subtitle: Avenue I corridor
cards.notes: See where many students live off-campus in this modern residential building featuring a rooftop deck and co-working spaces.
cards.short_summary: A major off-campus student housing complex located one block from campus.
cards.evidence_claim: FOUND Study Midwood at 3009 Avenue I provides furnished student apartments within walking distance of Brooklyn College.
cards.access_notes: Private residence; lobby access for residents and guests only.

cards.title: Ocean Avenue Entrance
cards.subtitle: Ocean Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Enter the campus through this western gate to access the West Quad and enjoy views of the college's Georgian-style architecture.
cards.short_summary: The western pedestrian and vehicular entrance to the Brooklyn College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ocean Avenue/Avenue H entrance is a primary access point for students entering the western side of the Brooklyn College campus.
cards.access_notes: Open during campus hours; ID required for entry.

cards.title: Bedford Avenue Gates
cards.subtitle: Bedford Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Pass through these iconic gates to reach the East and West Quads, located along the tree-lined Bedford Avenue thoroughfare.
cards.short_summary: The central pedestrian gates providing access to the heart of the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bedford Avenue Gates serve as major entry points to the East and West Quads of Brooklyn College.
cards.access_notes: Open 7:15 AM to 11 PM on weekdays; ID required.

cards.title: Student Center Corridor
cards.subtitle: Campus Road corridor
cards.notes: Walk along Campus Road to reach the Student Center, home to student government offices, a game room, and the historic copper beech tree.
cards.short_summary: The southern perimeter road housing the primary hub for student activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brooklyn College Student Center is located on Campus Road between East 27th Street and Amersfort Place.
cards.source_title: About Us - Student Center - Brooklyn College
cards.access_notes: Student Center is open 9 AM to 5 PM; campus road is public.

cards.title: East 27th Street Entrance
cards.subtitle: East 27th Street corridor
cards.notes: Use this entrance for direct access to the Student Center and Whitehead Hall, located on the southeastern edge of the campus.
cards.short_summary: A key pedestrian entrance serving the Student Center and academic buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: The East 27th Street entrance provides access to the Student Center and Whitehead Hall at Brooklyn College.
cards.access_notes: Open during campus hours; ID required for building entry.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique rituals and historic practices that define the Brooklyn College experience, from the iconic Lily Pond to the legacy of the Brooklyn Bridges.

cards.title: The Lily Pond Graduation Portraits
cards.subtitle: A rite of passage for every graduating senior
cards.notes: Visit the Lily Pond on the East Quad to snap your official graduation photos; it is the most iconic backdrop for BC seniors.
cards.short_summary: The Lily Pond is the central aesthetic landmark of the campus and the primary site for graduation photography.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lily Pond is described as a signature campus feature where students like Nariba Cintron are pictured, and it is a 'happy place' for alumni.
cards.access_notes: Open to students and the public during campus hours; located on the East Quad.

cards.title: The Buster Face Reveal
cards.subtitle: Commencement's high-energy mascot tradition
cards.notes: Watch the 'Buster the Bulldog Face Reveal' video during the commencement ceremony to kick off the graduation festivities.
cards.short_summary: Buster the Bulldog is the official mascot, and his presence is a staple of major campus events and graduation ceremonies.
cards.evidence_claim: The 101st Commencement Ceremony featured a 'Buster the Bulldog Face Reveal Video' as part of the official program.
cards.access_notes: Occurs annually during the spring commencement ceremony.

cards.title: The Unspoken Booth Tradition
cards.subtitle: A daily social anchor in the basement of Boylan
cards.notes: Meet friends at a cafeteria booth in Boylan Hall; it's a long-standing 'unspoken tradition' for commuters to gather here.
cards.short_summary: The Boylan Hall cafeteria serves as the primary social hub for the commuter-heavy student body to connect between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Students describe meeting at a booth in the cafeteria as an 'unspoken tradition' and a vital space for socialization.
cards.source_title: Opinion: Where's The Coffee?!? - The Brooklyn College Vanguard
cards.access_notes: Located in the basement of Boylan Hall; open Monday-Thursday 8 AM-7 PM.

cards.title: The 'Brooklyn Bridges' Identity
cards.subtitle: Honoring the former unique mascot
cards.notes: Look for vintage 'Brooklyn Bridges' gear in the archives; the school was the only one in the nation with a bridge mascot until 2010.
cards.short_summary: Before becoming the Bulldogs, Brooklyn College teams were known as the Bridges, a unique nod to the borough's architecture.
cards.evidence_claim: From the mid-nineties to 2010, the mascot was the Brooklyn Bridge, and the teams were called the Brooklyn Bridges.
cards.source_title: Opinion: Bring Back The Brooklyn Bridges
cards.access_notes: Historical mascot; memorabilia can be found in the Brooklyn College Archives.

cards.title: The Historic Country Fair
cards.subtitle: A legacy of campus-wide celebration
cards.notes: Learn about the Country Fair tradition started by Dean Bildersee, which evolved from the college's early 'Field Day' celebrations.
cards.short_summary: The Country Fair was a major historical tradition at Brooklyn College, serving as a primary social event for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: Dean Bildersee began the tradition of Country Fair, which followed the earlier 'Field Day' birthday celebrations.
cards.access_notes: Historical tradition; details preserved in the Brooklyn College Archives.

cards.title: The Alumni Oral History Project
cards.subtitle: Preserving the 'Brooklyn College Story'
cards.notes: Contribute your memories to the Oral History Project to ensure your student experience becomes a permanent part of the college archives.
cards.short_summary: The college actively collects personal stories from alumni to preserve the cultural history of the institution.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brooklyn College Alumni Oral History Project invites alumni to share their stories to preserve memories and accomplishments.
cards.source_title: Alumni Oral History Publication | Brooklyn College
cards.access_notes: Managed by the Office of Alumni Engagement.

cards.title: The Clock Tower Landmark
cards.subtitle: The campus's Georgian-style focal point
cards.notes: Look up at the LaGuardia Library clock tower, the signature building of the campus and a landmark for the Midwood community.
cards.short_summary: The clock tower on LaGuardia Hall is the architectural heart of the campus and its most recognizable symbol.
cards.evidence_claim: The library and its magnificent clock tower became the signature building of the Georgian-style campus.
cards.source_title: The Brooklyn College Library: The Heart of the Academy
cards.access_notes: Visible from the East Quad; library access requires a CUNY ID.

cards.title: The Annual FallFest
cards.subtitle: A signature student life event
cards.notes: Attend FallFest to experience one of the SAIL Center's signature programs designed to build campus pride and community.
cards.short_summary: FallFest is a major recurring event that brings the student body together for social and cultural activities.
cards.evidence_claim: FallFest is listed as a 'Signature Program' by the Student Activities, Involvement, and Leadership (SAIL) Center.
cards.source_title: Student Activities, Involvement, and Leadership (SAIL) - Brooklyn College
cards.access_notes: Held annually in the fall; open to all current students.

cards.title: Homecoming at Midwood Field
cards.subtitle: A shared community sports tradition
cards.notes: Head to Midwood Field for the Homecoming game to see the cheer team and band perform in a display of school spirit.
cards.short_summary: Midwood Field is the site for major athletic traditions, including the annual Homecoming festivities.
cards.evidence_claim: Homecoming games at Midwood Field feature performances by the cheer team, band, and step team.
cards.source_title: Hornets Find Their Footing in Homecoming Victory
cards.access_notes: Located just north of the main campus; events are typically seasonal.

cards.title: Bulldogs United Retreat
cards.subtitle: Building leadership and unity
cards.notes: Apply for the Bulldogs United Student Retreat to participate in a signature program focused on personal development and campus unity.
cards.short_summary: This retreat is a key tradition for student leaders to foster inclusivity and strengthen the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bulldogs United Student Retreat is a signature program offered by the SAIL Center to enhance student development.
cards.source_title: Student Activities, Involvement, and Leadership (SAIL) - Brooklyn College
cards.access_notes: Requires application through the SAIL Center; typically held annually.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at CUNY Brooklyn College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A sequence of campus landmarks and student activities to help new students navigate their first weekend at Brooklyn College.

cards.title: Morning Reflection at the Lily Pond
cards.subtitle: A serene campus landmark
cards.notes: Visit this tranquil spot to see the resident turtles and koi. It's a perfect place to relax between orientation sessions or find a quiet moment.
cards.short_summary: A peaceful campus pond home to turtles and koi fish.
cards.evidence_claim: The lily pond is a tranquil campus feature home to turtles and koi, described as a place for students to unwind.
cards.source_title: What the Campus Has to Offer | Brooklyn College
cards.access_notes: Open to students during campus hours; located near the center of the quad.

cards.title: Lunch at BK Campus Eats
cards.subtitle: Main campus dining hub
cards.notes: Head to the basement of Boylan Hall for global cuisine, including Latin and South Asian specialties. It's the primary spot for weekend-ready meals.
cards.short_summary: The central campus cafeteria offering diverse global food options.
cards.evidence_claim: The Boylan Hall cafeteria, operated by BK Campus Eats, offers global cuisine and is located on the basement level.
cards.source_title: BK Campus Eats: Boylan Hall Cafeteria - BC Knowledge for Students
cards.access_notes: Located in the basement of Boylan Hall; check seasonal hours for weekend availability.

cards.title: Afternoon Games in the Student Center
cards.subtitle: Recreation and socializing
cards.notes: Enjoy free pool and foosball on the first floor. It's a great way to meet fellow new students in a low-pressure environment.
cards.short_summary: A recreational space for students featuring pool and foosball.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Center Game Room on the first floor offers free pool games and foosball for students.
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of the Student Center; open to all students with ID.

cards.title: Workout at the West Quad
cards.subtitle: Campus health and wellness
cards.notes: Keep up your routine at the modern fitness center. Access is included for students, providing a space for independent exercise.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus fitness facility for student recreational use.
cards.evidence_claim: The West Quad Fitness Center offers independent exercise and recreational use for Brooklyn College students.
cards.source_title: West Quad Fitness Center - Facilities - Brooklyn College Athletics
cards.access_notes: Requires valid student identification for entry; check current recreation hours.

cards.title: Late Afternoon Study at the Library Cafe
cards.subtitle: 24/7-style study space
cards.notes: Located in Whitehead Hall, this cafe provides a focused environment for getting ahead on your first-week readings.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated study cafe located within Whitehead Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library Cafe is located in Whitehead Hall and serves as a key study facility for students.
cards.access_notes: Located in Whitehead Hall; check specific library cafe hours for weekend access.

cards.title: Evening Walk on the East Quad
cards.subtitle: Historic campus center
cards.notes: Stroll through the grassy quad surrounded by Georgian-style buildings. It's the heart of the campus and ideal for a sunset walk.
cards.short_summary: The central grassy quadrangle of the Brooklyn College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The campus features grassy quadrangles planted with elm trees, with the East Quad being a primary student gathering area.
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor area accessible to the campus community.

cards.title: Explore the Midwood Neighborhood
cards.subtitle: Local dining and shopping
cards.notes: Walk just off campus to Avenue J to explore local bakeries and kosher restaurants. It's a great way to get to know the surrounding community.
cards.short_summary: A nearby commercial street known for local bakeries and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Avenue J is described as one of Midwood's commercial hearts, offering local bakeries and restaurants.
cards.access_notes: Public street corridor within walking distance of the campus.

cards.title: Discover Campus History
cards.subtitle: Special collections and research
cards.notes: Visit the archives to learn about the college's 90-year history. It's a quiet space for deep dives into the school's legacy.
cards.short_summary: The library's repository for historical documents and special collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brooklyn College Library houses Archives & Special Collections, which are available for student research.
cards.source_title: Archives & Special Collections - Brooklyn College Library
cards.access_notes: Located within the library; check for specific archive hours or appointment requirements.

cards.title: Sunday Morning Tennis
cards.subtitle: Outdoor recreation
cards.notes: Grab a friend and head to the campus tennis courts for some fresh air and exercise before the Monday classes begin.
cards.short_summary: Outdoor tennis facilities available for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: The campus recreation facilities include tennis courts available for student use.
cards.source_title: Campus recreation facilities - BC Knowledge for Students
cards.access_notes: Outdoor courts; access is subject to weather and campus recreation policies.

cards.title: Sunday Evening Reflection
cards.subtitle: Peaceful campus space
cards.notes: End your weekend with a moment of peace in the Quiet Reflection Room. It's a dedicated space for mindfulness and personal thought.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet space for student reflection and mindfulness.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Center features a Quiet Reflection Room for students to wind down and have quiet time.
cards.access_notes: Located within the Student Center; open during building operating hours.
